context:
Treat cleanup as a controlled operations task. First prove the root cause is
fixed or guarded. Then inventory all repo and pool worktree local
`benchmark_runs` trees, classify datagen-only duplicates versus durable
result evidence, compare against the shared root, and ask for explicit
approval with exact paths and byte counts before deletion. Finish with a
representative external-root smoke to prove cleanup does not immediately
regress.
description:
Once output-root propagation and artifact guardrails are in place, audit and
clean the already-written duplicate generated data from repo and pool
worktrees.

Known duplicate/generated locations from the 2026-06-01 investigation:

- `/Users/joe/Developer/BenchBox/benchmark_runs`: about 6.2G, mostly
  `datagen/`, containing SF1 data for TPCH variants, Vector Search, H2ODB,
  SSB, Nyctaxi, ClickBench, and related benchmarks.
- `/Users/joe/Developer/BenchBox.pool-01/benchmark_runs`: about 4.2G,
  mostly `datagen/`, with large files including `tpch_skew_sf1/lineitem.tbl`,
  `vector_search_sf1/vectors.csv.zst`, `h2odb_sf1/trips.tbl.zst`,
  `ssb_sf1/lineorder.tbl.zst`, `nyctaxi_1.0/trips.csv.zst`, and
  `clickbench_sf1/hits.csv.zst`.

Cleanup must happen only after the root cause is fixed or protected, because
otherwise the next UAT/corpus run can recreate the same duplicate data.
Cleanup must also preserve any unique result bundles, manifests, or evidence
that are not redundant with the shared root under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`.

anti_patterns.dont: clean before the output-root bug is fixed or guarded
delete result bundles or manifests just because they live under a duplicate root
anti_patterns.why: classify and preserve unique evidence first.

anti_patterns.dont: run `rm -rf` from a parent directory or with a glob
anti_patterns.why: cleanup must list exact approved paths.

anti_patterns.dont: use Docker/system prune as part of this task
anti_patterns.why: the target is BenchBox-generated filesystem data only.

preserves.behavior: Cleanup commands are path-specific; no global filesystem prune or unbounded recursive deletion.
Git-tracked files and pool worktree metadata are untouched.
No deletion happens until `benchmark-runs-output-root-propagation` and `benchmark-runs-local-artifact-guardrails` are merged or explicitly confirmed active.
Unique result JSON, manifests, lifecycle logs, and submission evidence are preserved before any datagen cleanup.

prior_art.concept: benchmark_runs/ repository ignore conventions — preserve generated data out of git
docs/operations/uat-framework.md:Long-Running UAT — reuse shared-root conventions for durable UAT evidence
tests/uat validation/submission tooling — use existing manifest/result validators before discarding any non-datagen evidence

verifications.expected: all candidate local benchmark_runs paths are listed and classified

verifications.description: Cleanup approval names exact paths and byte counts
verifications.expected: user approval explicitly covers each destructive path

verifications.description: Post-cleanup audit shows approved duplicate paths removed or reduced as expected
verifications.expected: approved duplicate datagen paths are absent or no longer contain redundant generated data

verifications.command: BENCHBOX_OUTPUT_DIR=~/Developer/benchmark_runs uv run -- benchbox run --platform duckdb --benchmark tpch --scale 0.01 --queries Q1 --phases generate --non-interactive
verifications.description: External-root smoke does not recreate worktree-local generated data
verifications.expected: shared root receives expected output; active worktree-local benchmark_runs remains absent or unchanged

work_units.notes:

found, move it to the approved shared root or an agreed archive location
before deleting the duplicate worktree-local tree.
